examples.description: Remove a quote line only if nobody changed it since your read

failure_modes.recovery: Call quote_item_list with the quote_id to find the line id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not name a live quote line in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Resend with expected_updated_at set to the line's updated_at from your read (the refusal names the current value; invoice_item_read or quote_item_read shows the line).
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at is missing: every line edit or removal carries the updated_at of the line it was made against

failure_modes.recovery: Read the quote's converted_invoice_id and change that invoice's lines instead (invoice_item_create, invoice_item_update); issue a new quote for new work.
failure_modes.when: the quote (or the quote a line is moved to) is converted: its invoice was copied from its lines, so they no longer change (already_converted: true)

failure_modes.recovery: Call quote_item_read to see the current line, then decide again; nothing was written.
failure_modes.when: the line changed since the read expected_updated_at came from

preconditions: Soft delete: the line leaves the quote and its totals immediately; the row is retired for audit history, never removed.

description: Soft-deletes a quote line — it leaves the quote and its totals immediately, but the row is retired for audit history, never removed. expected_updated_at is required: the line's updated_at from your read (quote_item_read); without it the removal is refused and the refusal names the current value. Refuses with CONFLICT when the line changed since that read (read it again and decide on the current line) and on a converted quote (its lines are frozen: change its invoice instead). NEXT: quote_read to see the quote.

expected_updated_at.description: Required: the line's updated_at from your last read (quote_item_read, quote_item_list or the create answer). Left out, the call is refused and names the current value; a line changed since then returns CONFLICT with the current value and stays as it is.

name: quote_item_delete
